item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0010-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0010-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0010-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0010-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0010-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0010-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0010-E007","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The report stated that security forces used “rotation” by filing new cases on the same terrorism-related charges to keep detainees arbitrarily detained despite judicial release orders; it also reported that authorities failed to treat women and girls detained for alleged ISIS-family ties as possible victims and, in documented cases, did not provide rehabilitation services.","notes":["The excerpt supports failure to provide rehabilitation services, but does not establish a general failure to provide reintegration services."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0010-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0010-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0010-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0010-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0010-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0010-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
